title: Pro-Active Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.34681v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating a population mean is fundamental across scientific applications, but observing every outcome can be prohibitively expensive. Often, covariates and machine learning (ML) predictions are available for the full population, even when only a small subset of outcomes can be observed. How can we leverage this information to proactively select observations to label, update ML predictions as labels arrive, and construct statistically valid confidence intervals? We develop a general, without-replacement formulation of Pro-Active Inference (PAI), extending our earlier with-replacement approach and building on Active Statistical Inference. Rather than making fixed-order label-skip decisions, PAI proactively selects which observation to label next from the remaining covariate pool while accommodating online ML updates. translated_abstract: 估计总体均值是各类科学应用中的基础问题，但对每一个结果都进行观测的代价可能极其高昂。通常，即使只能观测到一小部分结果，协变量和机器学习（ML）预测在整个总体上都是可获得的。我们如何利用这些信息来主动选择需要标注的观测、在标签到来时更新机器学习预测，并构建统计上有效的置信区间？我们提出了主动推断（Pro-Active Inference, PAI）的一个一般化的不放回抽样框架，扩展了我们先前的有放回方法，并建立在主动统计推断的基础之上。PAI 不再按固定顺序做出跳过标签的决策，而是在剩余的协变量池中主动选择下一个要标注的观测，同时支持机器学习模型的在线更新。我们证明了 PAI 的有限样本无偏性和渐近有效性，并开发了一种改进的有限样本方差估计方法。
tldr: 提出了不放回抽样框架下的主动推断（PAI）方法，可在机器学习预测在线更新的同时主动选择下一个标注样本，并给出具有有限样本无偏性和渐近有效性的统计推断保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes a general without-replacement formulation of Pro-Active Inference (PAI) that proactively selects which observation to label next while accommodating online ML updates, with finite-sample unbiasedness and asymptotically valid confidence intervals.
